mapper.update: UPDATE users SET pin_auth_id = #{pinAuthId}, auth_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, auth_is_used = 0, pin_fail_count = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_session (user_card_id, session_token, status, amount, expires_at) VALUES (#{userCardId}, #{sessionToken}, #{status}, #{amount}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_session SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = 'MOCK_RANDOM_DECLINE' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}

UPDATE user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN payment_transaction pt ON pt.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND pt.payment_session_id = #{paymentSessionId} LEFT JOIN benefit_service bs ON bs.service_id = pt.applied_benefit_service_id SET uc.balance = uc.balance - CASE WHEN bs.benefit_type = 'CASHBACK' THEN pt.final_amount ELSE pt.amount END WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0 AND cp.card_type = 'DEBIT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_transaction (user_card_id, store_id, payment_session_id, amount, discount_amount, final_amount, paid_at, is_used_app, applied_benefit_service_id, applied_tier_id, better_user_card_id, alternative_discount_amount, missed_amount) VALUES (#{userCardId}, #{storeId}, #{paymentSessionId}, #{amount}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{paidAt}, 1, #{appliedBenefitServiceId}, #{appliedTierId}, #{betterUserCardId}, #{alternativeDiscountAmount}, #{missedAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT ps.payment_id, ps.status, pt.payment_transaction_id, s.store_name, cp.card_name AS payment_method, pt.amount, CASE WHEN bs.point_currency_id IS NOT NULL THEN pt.discount_amount * pc.krw_per_point ELSE pt.discount_amount END AS expected_benefit_amount, pt.paid_at FROM payment_session ps JOIN payment_transaction pt ON pt.payment_session_id = ps.payment_session_id JOIN store s ON s.store_id = pt.store_id JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = pt.user_card_id JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id LEFT JOIN benefit_service bs ON bs.service_id = pt.applied_benefit_service_id LEFT JOIN point_currency pc ON pc.point_currency_id = bs.point_currency_id WHERE ps.payment_session_id = #{paymentSessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_session (user_card_id, session_token, payment_id, store_id, amount, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{userCardId}, #{sessionToken}, #{paymentId}, #{storeId}, #{amount}, 'SCANNED', #{expiresAt})
